levels.surface: أبو جعفر محمد بن علي بن الحسين
أبي جعفر محمد بن علي بن الحسين

notes: The Imam written after «عن» (أبي جعفر محمد بن علي بن الحسين) stays narrator (owner ruling 2); the chain ends at the Imam's father and grandfather, named only by relation (rule 7).
The surface أبي jumps from relation to narrator at level 2; the first occurrence of the word أبي is the relation.
The honorific «عليهم السلام» is left out.
